response.original_title: (Escalate-Guide) How do I escalate an issue on Virgin Voyages Cruise
response.overview: To escalate an issue on a Virgin Voyages Cruise, start by speaking directly with onboard Guest Services +1-866-829-1280 (US) or +44-204-586-5316 (UK) or your personal suite steward/butler, and request a supervisor or the Hotel Director if the matter remains unresolved. Onboard Escalation (While on the Ship)  First Step:+1-866-829-1280 (US) Report the issue immediately to the Guest Services desk or the specific department head involved (such as dining or housekeeping). Second Step: If frontline staff cannot fix it, ask to speak with the Guest Services Manager or the Hotel Director while still onboard. Tip: Keep notes of names, dates, and times of every conversation you have while on the ship.  Post-Cruise Escalation (After the Voyage)  Phone Support: Call Virgin Voyage customer service at +1-866-829-1280 (US)(North America) or +1-866-829-1280 (US) (Headquarters/International sales) to request a supervisor or post-cruise guest relations.
